summary: The production-candidate claim fails software-reproducibility review. Default GUI, single-slice, batch, and tuner entry points do not automatically load the claimed v5.7.1 production profile; the documented study CLI imports the frozen v5.7 implementation instead of v5.7.1; and importing v5.7.1 fails when neither the repository nor home directory permits log writes. Focused pytest validation was unavailable because pytest is not installed, while the tuner self-check and pipeline --help both failed at import-time logging. The checkpoint file itself matches the profile SHA-256, and static AST parsing passed.

findings.title: Production profile is not the default for GUI, single-slice, batch, or tuner execution
findings.impact: Ordinary v5.7.1 invocations execute classical Saturn semantics rather than the claimed dual-head U-Net-primary checkpoint and thresholds. Results depend on an undocumented operational step, and supported entry points do not agree.

findings.recommendation: Make the versioned production profile the explicit default for production entry points, or require a profile and fail closed. Add integration tests asserting resolved profile name, engine, output mode, checkpoint role, thresholds, and SHA-256 for GUI, single, batch, tuner, and study workflows.

findings.title: Study command runs v5.7 code instead of v5.7.1
findings.impact: The command-line study workflow cannot substantiate consistent v5.7.1 measurement, body-width, reporting, or version provenance semantics, even when given the v5.7.1 profile.

findings.recommendation: Provide a v5.7.1 study launcher that imports the reviewed v5.7.1 pipeline, pins or verifies the production profile, records the pipeline commit/version, and is covered by a synthetic end-to-end study test.

findings.title: Import-time logging makes read-only installations unusable
findings.impact: The pipeline, tuner, tests, and even --help cannot run when both source and home directories are non-writable, which is a realistic packaged, managed, or shared-compute deployment condition.
evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:9-21
Command `python sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py --help` raised PermissionError for scratch/runtime_logs/sperm_error_log.txt and C:\Users\dmishra\sperm_error_log.txt.
Command `python utils/tune_parameters_Saturnv5_7_1.py --self-check` failed with the same import-time errors.
findings.recommendation: Do not require file creation during module import. Initialize logging after argument parsing, use an OS-approved writable application-data or temporary location, and degrade to stderr-only logging if file logging is unavailable. Add a read-only-directory subprocess test.

findings.title: Required validation suite is not reproducible from the declared environment
findings.impact: The automated and adversarial validation criterion cannot be independently reproduced, and static inspection cannot replace executable confirmation of measurement, tracking, reporting, and failure paths.
evidence: Command `python -m pytest -q tests/test_saturn_v571_dual_head.py tests/test_saturn_v571_body_width.py tests/test_saturn_v57_multisample.py tests/test_tuner_v57.py tests/test_torch_device.py` returned `No module named pytest`.
requirements.txt does not provide evidence in this review that pytest is installed in the active environment.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md identifies validation artifacts, but the focused commands could not be reproduced.
findings.recommendation: Document and pin a validation environment including pytest and all report dependencies, provide a single focused validation command, and preserve its machine-readable results with interpreter and dependency versions.

findings.title: Entry-point and production-profile integration paths are largely untested
findings.impact: Unit-level assertions can pass while launchers silently select the wrong pipeline or defaults, as demonstrated by the v5.7 study import and optional production profile.

findings.impact: The reviewed commit does not fully identify the evaluated filesystem state. In particular, the study launcher imports the modified v5.7 file, so its behavior may differ from commit d8c498c.

findings.recommendation: Audit and release from a clean, uniquely identified tree. Include a manifest of tracked source, profile, checkpoint, dependency lock, and generated validation artifacts.

limitations: No full image stack was run, as required by the review instructions.
Pytest-based focused tests could not execute because pytest is absent from the active Python environment.
GUI widgets were not launched interactively; GUI semantics were traced statically through their handlers.
Cross-device CUDA, MPS, and CPU inference equivalence was not measured.
Other reviewers' outputs were not read.
recommended_follow_up: Fix the blocking entry-point/profile and study-version inconsistencies, then create a superseding audit run.
Make module import and --help succeed without writable source or home directories.
Install or provision the pinned validation environment and rerun the focused v5.7.1, multisample, tuner, report, and device tests.
Add synthetic entry-point integration tests that inspect resolved production configuration and generated report/provenance files.
Repeat the review from a clean worktree and record exact dependency and device information.
